direct_collision: Direct collision with claiming listwise target ranking as new
not_claimed: Drug-centric or listwise ranking is not new and is only an auxiliary loss.
eqir_specific_difference: The candidate estimand is the incremental value of qualified structure evidence after a frozen cross-fitted nonstructural offset, under both query directions.
required_falsification: FULL_EQIR_WITHOUT_DRUG_QUERY_LOSS and FULL_EQIR_WITHOUT_TARGET_QUERY_LOSS; both grouped directional bootstraps and within-drug permutation gate.

direct_collision: Direct collision with generic reliability gating
eqir_specific_difference: Qualification is a deterministic label-independent receptor/QC predicate; the optional branch may only fit cross-fitted residuals and cannot relearn the full label.
required_falsification: Compare full EQIR with no qualification and with no residualization under identical frozen base predictions.

not_claimed: Structure-quality weighting or pLDDT-guided fusion is not claimed.
eqir_specific_difference: Experimental evidence availability controls whether a residual increment is legally defined; quality does not supply a generic learned fusion weight.
required_falsification: Qualification-independence audit plus target-QC-feature ablation and exact fallback equality test.

direct_collision: Direct collision with generic target-prior debiasing
not_claimed: Generic target-prior or causal debiasing is not claimed.
eqir_specific_difference: EQIR does not estimate a causal target-prior intervention; it asks whether target-local structural evidence explains held-out residual interaction signal beyond a frozen base.
required_falsification: Within-target and within-drug score-permutation nulls, macro-directional paired bootstrap, and no-residualization ablation.

direct_collision: Collision with Sinkhorn or OT bidirectional retrieval as standalone novelty
not_claimed: Mutual retrieval and optimal transport are not claimed; EQIR uses no OT pseudo-labeling.
eqir_specific_difference: The two query directions constrain the incremental residual value rather than define a new retrieval architecture.
required_falsification: Remove each query loss separately; require structure increment to retain both directional gains versus the nonnovel blend.

direct_collision: Collision with generic cold-start multimodal alignment
not_claimed: Cold-start alignment is not claimed as a new mechanism.
eqir_specific_difference: Scaffold and homology cold axes are identification and stress-test axes for the qualified residual, not the source of novelty.
required_falsification: Both target-homology-cluster and drug-scaffold bootstrap lower bounds must exceed zero.

direct_collision: Collision with claiming optional structure assistance and sequence fallback as new
not_claimed: Optional structure with sequence fallback is not claimed by itself.
eqir_specific_difference: When qualification is zero, the final logit is definitionally and bitwise the frozen base; when one, structure can only explain a cross-fitted pseudo-residual.
required_falsification: Bitwise exact fallback audit and BASE_PLUS_RESIDUAL_WITHOUT_EXACT_FALLBACK_CONSTRAINT ablation.

direct_collision: Direct collision with a generic pocket branch or structure graph encoder
not_claimed: Pocket detection, pocket encoding, or atom-residue fusion is not claimed.
eqir_specific_difference: The method consumes a frozen strict experimental-pocket protocol and studies incremental evidence value; it does not propose a pocket encoder.
required_falsification: Receptor/hash/redocking qualification audit; pocket/QC inputs cannot read current-fold interaction labels.

not_claimed: MNAR interaction-label learning is not claimed.
eqir_specific_difference: The missing object is structural evidence observation, not an unobserved DTI label; missing evidence forces an exact base estimand rather than an imputed negative.
required_falsification: Verify all missing or failed structure routes have a(t)=0 and zero logit delta; never encode absence as y=0.

direct_collision: Collision with claiming nonhomologous new-target discovery as a method novelty
not_claimed: Nonhomologous pocket hopping is an application, not the algorithm claim.
eqir_specific_difference: Any novel-target case is supported only if the same frozen qualified-residual mechanism generalizes under homology-cold evaluation.
required_falsification: Homology-cluster bootstrap, locked S3 confirmation, and separate new-target application audit.

direct_collision: Direct collision with generic optional-branch or skip-missing novelty
not_claimed: Dynamic skipping or arbitrary missing-modality fusion is not claimed.
eqir_specific_difference: EQIR uses a frozen nonstructural offset, deterministic eligibility, residual-only supervision, and an exact functional invariant rather than a flexible modality fusion network.
required_falsification: No-qualification, no-residualization, and no-exact-fallback ablations must each be inferior to full EQIR.

direct_collision: Collision with generic dynamic fusion or DANN as a core claim
not_claimed: Dynamic sequence/graph fusion and domain-adversarial alignment are not claimed or used as the core.
eqir_specific_difference: The candidate contribution is evidence-qualified incremental residual estimation with directional value constraints, not a new encoder or domain discriminator.
required_falsification: Beat same-data DTIAM, BioMaster V1, and the frozen nonnovel blend with identical cold axes and five-seed evidence.

direct_collision: Direct collision with claiming orthogonal multimodal fusion as new
not_claimed: Orthogonal representations or orthogonal sequential fusion are not claimed; the term is removed from the candidate claim.
eqir_specific_difference: The structure branch is constrained by label-independent legal eligibility, a frozen cross-fitted offset, exact no-evidence invariance, and two directional incremental-value gates rather than an orthogonality loss.
required_falsification: Qualification, no-residualization, no-exact-fallback, and both query-loss ablations plus dual-axis grouped bootstrap.

direct_collision: Direct collision with claiming residual fusion as a standalone innovation
not_claimed: Residual multimodal feature fusion is not claimed; residual networks and residual fusion long predate EQIR.
eqir_specific_difference: Residual learning is restricted to an induced probability increment over a frozen strongest nonstructural offset and is zero by construction outside a label-independent eligible set.
required_falsification: Full mechanism must beat direct fusion and no-residualization controls while satisfying bitwise fallback and both directional gates.

direct_collision: Direct collision with claiming fine-grained drug-protein interaction maps; gated bidirectional fusion; graph-sequence cross-attention; or residual fusion as EQIR novelty
not_claimed: Fine-grained atom-residue maps; graph-sequence cross-attention; bidirectional gating; and residual fusion are not claimed.
eqir_specific_difference: GADFDTI and GATv2-TransDTI learn complete warm-start interaction predictors; EQIR conditionally permits only a probability-scale increment over a frozen cold-protocol base and must equal that base when evidence is ineligible.
required_falsification: Compare full EQIR with direct structure fusion and no-residualization variants under S3; require both cold-axis bootstrap lower bounds and both directional value gates.

prior_work: Batch Spectral Shrinkage; Fair Classifiers that Abstain without Harm; Calibrated Regression Against An Adversary Without Regret
direct_collision: Direct collision with claiming safe adaptation, no-harm learning, baseline-relative regret or CVaR-style risk control as standalone EQIR novelty
not_claimed: Safe transfer, no-harm learning, baseline regret, CVaR and group-risk constraints are not claimed as new.
eqir_specific_difference: The candidate restricts a structure adapter by a label-independent experimental-evidence predicate, freezes the cross-fitted DTI base, measures relative ranking regret separately over target and old-drug query groups, controls both upper tails, and is bitwise identical to the base outside eligibility.
required_falsification: Compare full safe-dual-query EQIR with the ordinary dual-query objective, target-only and drug-only risk constraints, no-qualification and no-exact-fallback variants, all TCP-inspired controls and both TAPB-inspired controls; require five-seed, dual-cold-axis and both directional gates.

direct_collision: Direct collision with claiming multisource feature decoupling, ordinary multiview fusion, cross-property attention or dynamic auxiliary branch weights as standalone BioMaster novelty
not_claimed: Multisource feature decoupling, homogeneous feature preservation, shared cross-property attention and dynamic multibranch loss weighting are not claimed as new.
eqir_specific_difference: EQIR does not depend on a new fusion backbone: it conditionally adapts a frozen cross-fitted DTI base only where experimental evidence is label-independently eligible, is exactly identical to the base otherwise, and controls base-relative ranking-regret upper tails separately for target and old-drug queries.
required_falsification: Compare full EQIR with frozen-base, capacity-matched direct multiview fusion and multibranch auxiliary-supervision controls under identical leak-free S1-S3 folds and five seeds; require both cold-axis confidence intervals, target-macro noninferiority, drug-macro improvement and both directional permutation gates.

direct_collision: Direct collision with claiming asymmetric multimodal gating, dynamic frequency decomposition, latent-space signal disentanglement or bidirectional cross-view alignment as standalone BioMaster novelty
not_claimed: Asymmetric dynamic gating, anisotropic/dynamic decomposition, latent signal coordination and bidirectional interactive alignment are not claimed as new.
eqir_specific_difference: EQIR leaves the fusion backbone deliberately small and instead defines where structure may change a frozen cross-fitted base, requires exact identity outside label-independent eligibility and constrains the upper tail of base-relative ranking regret in both target and old-drug query groups.
required_falsification: Compare full EQIR with corrected capacity-matched asymmetric-gated and bidirectional-alignment controls on the same S1-S3 folds and five seeds; require dual cold-axis confidence intervals, target-macro noninferiority, drug-macro improvement, both query permutation gates and exact fallback.
